expectedIssues: Section title shows the raw translation key home_feed.popular_title instead of translated text
reportedIssues: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated label (e.g. 'Popular near you'), while the sibling section correctly shows 'Fastest near you'.

The favorite (heart) button treatment is inconsistent between cards: on the ramen card the heart sits directly on the image with no background, while on the pizza card it has a dark circular scrim. On light imagery the un-scrimmed white heart would be hard to see.
Secondary metadata text such as '€0.90 delivery' and '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen' uses light grey on white, which appears close to or below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio for small text.
